label: School, university, government or non-profit
summary: Precise eligibility criteria for programs, grants, and enrollments
Equitable language welcoming all community participants
tone_principles: Respectful, transparent, civic-minded, and welcoming. Avoid elitist jargon or misleading funding claims.
writing_style: Plain public-sector English with straightforward guidance and clear contact channels.
messaging_principles: All program criteria, admission requirements, and grant details must state conditions plainly.
do_examples: Applications are evaluated according to published civic criteria and community guidelines.
Donations may be eligible for tax deductibility under applicable non-profit regulations.
dont_examples: Get 100% free government money with zero eligibility checks guaranteed!
Our school guarantees 100% placement into top-tier executive roles!

rules.title: Substantiate Accreditation, Placement & Grant Claims
rules.description: Public and educational institutions must not promise guaranteed job placement or unconditional grants.

suggested_replacements.100% job placement guaranteed: structured career counseling and internship pathways
suggested_replacements.100% free government money: public grant assistance subject to eligibility criteria
suggested_replacements.guaranteed admission for everyone: accessible enrollment options based on admission requirements

rules.do_example: Students benefit from career workshops and institutional employer partnerships.
rules.dont_example: We guarantee 100% job placement for all graduating students.

rules.title: Maintain Accessible & Respectful Community Voice
rules.description: Avoid exclusionary administrative acronyms or bureaucratic dismissiveness.

suggested_replacements.ignorance is no excuse: our staff is available to clarify requirements

rules.do_example: Please contact our community liaison office if you need assistance submitting documents.
rules.dont_example: Compliance is a mandatory decree or face immediate penalties!

terminology.preferred: public grant funding for eligible applicants
terminology.notes: Public funding must be framed accurately according to statutory requirements.
Educational institutions should reference accredited standards.
